features.label: The popular versions are not translations
features.detail: The most-shared English Rumi is loose reworking that strips the Islamic framework out entirely.

features.label: A scholar before a mystic
features.detail: Trained jurist and theologian. The mysticism sits on top of rigorous formal religious learning.

features.label: Written out of loss
features.detail: The work erupts from the disappearance of Shams. It is grief, not serenity.
